The '''Hyperwave relay station''' was located ten thousand meters beneath [[Spire (Zakuul)|The Spire]], the capital city of the [[Eternal Empire]] of [[Zakuul]]. It contained the only source of the [[GEMINI]] frequency, which handled all communications between the [[Eternal Throne]] and the [[Eternal Fleet]]. In [[3630 BBY]] the [[Eternal Alliance|Anti-Zakuul Alliance]] obtained the detailed schematics from the Spire through the [[Overwatch]] and identified the Hyperwave relay station as a major target. [[Havoc Squad]] and [[Kaliyo Djannis]] were sent to clear out the path for [[Alliance Commander|The Alliance Commander]], but were forced to complete the [[Mission to the hyperwave relay station|mission]] on their own after the Commander went missing in [[Odessen]] wilderness. The combatants were cornered by [[Knights of Zakuul]] and [[Skytrooper]]s and in the resulting firefight four of six Havoc members were killed, while [[Aric Jorgan]] and Djannis were able to exfiltrate and return to Odessen.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Hyperwave relay station appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire]]'' '''Chapter 12: Visions in the Dark'''.
